description: UI layer — all Compose screens, components, theme, and the final MainActivity. Depends on FEAT-002 data layer being complete. Implements all 9 screens (Splash, Login, Register, Home, Menu, Peta, Laporan, Profile, Notifikasi), shared components (KpiCard, MenuCard, AppTopBar, NavBar), Material3 theme, and the NavHost in MainActivity.
steps: Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/theme/Color.kt — define Color constants matching the brand palette already in colors.xml: val BgnPrimary = Color(0xFF001026); val BgnPrimaryContainer = Color(0xFF0B2545); val BgnSecondary = Color(0xFF395F95); val BgnTertiaryFixed = Color(0xFF6FFBBE); val BgnBackground = Color(0xFFF8F9FF); val BgnSurface = Color(0xFFFFFFFF); val BgnOnSurface = Color(0xFF0B1C30); val BgnOnSurfaceVariant = Color(0xFF44474E); val StatusSuccess = Color(0xFF059669); val StatusWarning = Color(0xFFF59E0B); val StatusError = Color(0xFFEF4444).

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/theme/Theme.kt — RadarMBGTheme composable using lightColorScheme with primary=BgnPrimary, primaryContainer=BgnPrimaryContainer, secondary=BgnSecondary, background=BgnBackground, surface=BgnSurface, onSurface=BgnOnSurface, onSurfaceVariant=BgnOnSurfaceVariant, error=StatusError. Wrap content in MaterialTheme with this colorScheme and Typography(). Apply SystemBarStyle: status bar dark (primary color), nav bar light.
Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/theme/Type.kt — val Typography = Typography() using Material3 defaults. No custom font — system font is sufficient.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/components/KpiCard.kt — @Composable fun KpiCard(value: String, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier). Use ElevatedCard with corner radius 16dp, padding 16dp. Value: large bold text in BgnPrimary. Label: smaller text in BgnOnSurfaceVariant. Card fills half width in a 2-column LazyVerticalGrid.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/components/MenuCard.kt — @Composable fun MenuCard(menu: MenuData, modifier: Modifier = Modifier). Show school_target bold (primary color), menu_title (secondary), city chip, kalori badge (BgnTertiaryFixed bg + BgnPrimaryContainer text). Nutrisi row: protein, karbohidrat, lemak as small chips. Use ElevatedCard.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/components/AppTopBar.kt — @Composable fun AppTopBar(title: String, badgeCount: Int = 0, onNotificationClick: () -> Unit, onProfileClick: () -> Unit). Use TopAppBar with BgnPrimary background. Title in white. Right actions: notification IconButton with BadgedBox showing badgeCount if > 0, and profile avatar IconButton (circle with user initial in BgnTertiaryFixed).

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/components/NavBar.kt — @Composable fun RadarNavBar(selectedRoute: String, onNavigate: (String) -> Unit). NavigationBar with 4 items: beranda (ic_beranda drawable), menu (ic_menu_hari_ini drawable), peta (ic_distribusi drawable, relabeled as nav_peta), laporan (ic_laporan drawable). Highlight selected item with BgnPrimary tint. Routes: 'home', 'menu', 'peta', 'laporan'.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/SplashScreen.kt — @Composable fun SplashScreen(onNavigateToHome: () -> Unit, onNavigateToLogin: () -> Unit). Full-screen Box with BgnPrimary background. Center column: Image from painterResource(R.mipmap.ic_launcher) 120dp, Text('Radar MBG') bold 28sp white, Text(stringResource(R.string.bgn_institution_name)) 13sp lightblue. LaunchedEffect(Unit): call viewModel.checkSession(), collect uiState; on Success navigate to home, on LoggedOut navigate to login. Use authViewModel: AuthViewModel = viewModel(). CircularProgressIndicator in BgnTertiaryFixed while Loading.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/LoginScreen.kt — @Composable fun LoginScreen(onLoginSuccess: () -> Unit, onNavigateToRegister: () -> Unit, authViewModel: AuthViewModel = viewModel()). Column with BgnPrimary header (logo + Radar MBG title 1/3 height), white card body (2/3 height) with rounded top corners 24dp. Fields: OutlinedTextField for username and password (password with visualTransformation PasswordVisualTransformation + toggle). Button (BgnPrimary) calls viewModel.login(). TextButton links to Register. collectAsStateWithLifecycle on uiState: show CircularProgressIndicator on Loading, Snackbar or error Text on Error, call onLoginSuccess on Success.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/RegisterScreen.kt — @Composable fun RegisterScreen(onRegisterSuccess: () -> Unit, onNavigateToLogin: () -> Unit, authViewModel: AuthViewModel = viewModel()). Scrollable Column. Fields: nama lengkap, email, username, password, konfirmasi password. Role selection: Row of two RadioButton+Text pairs (user / sppg). Conditional: if role==sppg show OutlinedTextField for sppg_name. Validate: password == konfirmasi before calling viewModel.register(). Show error inline. On Success emit snackbar + navigate to login.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/HomeScreen.kt — @Composable fun HomeScreen(onNotificationClick: () -> Unit, onProfileClick: () -> Unit, homeViewModel: HomeViewModel = viewModel(), notifikasiViewModel: NotifikasiViewModel = viewModel()). Scaffold with AppTopBar (badge from notifikasiViewModel). Body: PullToRefreshBox (use accompanist or M3 experimental) wrapping LazyColumn. Items: (1) 2-column LazyVerticalGrid of 4 KpiCards: Sekolah Terlayani, Porsi Terdistribusi (formatted with NumberFormat), Kepatuhan AKG (% suffix), SPPG Aktif — all from homeUiState. (2) Section header 'Distribusi per Provinsi'. (3) For each ProvinsiData: Row with provinsi name, target_porsi, ketepatan %, status chip (green/yellow/red based on ketepatan >= 98 / >= 95 / < 95). Show loading shimmer (Box with animated alpha) while Loading. Show error card with retry button on Error.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/MenuScreen.kt — @Composable fun MenuScreen(menuViewModel: MenuViewModel = viewModel()). Scaffold. LaunchedEffect(Unit) calls loadMenu(). Body: Column. Filter chips row (LazyRow of FilterChip): 'Semua' + unique city names from kotaList. LazyColumn of MenuCard items. Empty state: illustration + text when filtered is empty. Loading shimmer while Loading.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/PetaScreen.kt — @Composable fun PetaScreen(homeViewModel: HomeViewModel = viewModel()). Scaffold with TopAppBar title peta_judul. Body: Column. Dropdown menu row (ExposedDropdownMenuBox) for wilayah selection: DKI Jakarta (lat -6.2, lng 106.816667), Jawa Barat (lat -6.9, lng 107.6), Jawa Tengah (lat -7.15, lng 110.1), Jawa Timur (lat -7.75, lng 112.5), Seluruh Indonesia (lat -2.5, lng 118.0). OSMDroid AndroidView taking remaining weight=1 space. In the AndroidView factory: create MapView, set tile source OpenStreetMap, enable multi-touch, disable built-in zoom controls (use GestureDetector for pinch), set center and zoom to selected wilayah. Markers: for each ProvinsiData in homeViewModel distribusi data, add a Marker at approximate province lat/lng with green drawable. Moving van markers: maintain a list of 3 blue Marker objects; use LaunchedEffect to update their positions +/- small random offset every 3000ms (simulate movement). On wilayah change, call mapController.animateTo(newCenter, newZoom, 1000L).

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/LaporanScreen.kt — @Composable fun LaporanScreen(laporanViewModel: LaporanViewModel = viewModel()). Scrollable Scaffold. Two sections divided by a HorizontalDivider: (1) Form aduan: nama, telepon, role selector (user/sppg/ortu), kategori selector (DropdownMenu: Kualitas Makanan, Keterlambatan, Porsi, Kebersihan, Lainnya), sekolah, tanggal (DatePickerDialog), deskripsi (multi-line), photo upload button (launches camera intent via FileProvider using rememberLauncherForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.TakePicture())). Submit button calls viewModel.submitLaporan(). (2) Tiket tracking: OutlinedTextField for tiket ID, Button calls viewModel.trackTiket(). Result card shows TiketData fields (status, kategori, catatan_satgas) with colored status badge.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/ProfileScreen.kt — @Composable fun ProfileScreen(onLogout: () -> Unit, authViewModel: AuthViewModel = viewModel()). Collect user from SessionDataStore flow (or from authViewModel uiState). Center column: large avatar circle with user initial (first char of full_name, uppercase) in BgnTertiaryFixed on BgnPrimaryContainer background 80dp circle. full_name bold, role_label subtitle, email secondary. Two OutlinedButtons: Ganti Kata Sandi (shows AlertDialog with current/new password fields — calls POST /api/change_password if that endpoint exists, otherwise show toast 'Fitur dalam pengembangan'), Keluar (shows confirmation AlertDialog, on confirm calls authViewModel.logout(), then onLogout callback).

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/ui/screens/NotifikasiScreen.kt — @Composable fun NotifikasiScreen(notifikasiViewModel: NotifikasiViewModel = viewModel()). LaunchedEffect(Unit) loads data. LazyColumn: badge summary card at top (X laporan masuk), then LazyColumn of latest_reports as LaporanReport cards showing ticket_code, reporter_name, school_target, issue_category, status chip, created_at. Empty state Box if list is empty. Pull to refresh supported.

Replace android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/MainActivity.kt — full final implementation. class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() { override fun onCreate(...) { super.onCreate(savedInstanceState); enableEdgeToEdge(); setContent { RadarMBGTheme { val navController = rememberNavController(); val authViewModel: AuthViewModel = viewModel(); NavHost(navController, startDestination = 'splash') { composable('splash') { SplashScreen(onNavigateToHome = { navController.navigate('main') { popUpTo('splash') { inclusive = true } } }, onNavigateToLogin = { navController.navigate('login') { popUpTo('splash') { inclusive = true } } }, authViewModel = authViewModel) }; composable('login') { LoginScreen(onLoginSuccess = { navController.navigate('main') { popUpTo('login') { inclusive = true } } }, onNavigateToRegister = { navController.navigate('register') }) }; composable('register') { RegisterScreen(onRegisterSuccess = { navController.navigate('login') { popUpTo('register') { inclusive = true } } }, onNavigateToLogin = { navController.popBackStack() }) }; composable('main') { MainScaffold(navController, authViewModel) }; composable('notifikasi') { NotifikasiScreen() } } } } }. Separate composable MainScaffold: has its own NavHost or uses nested navigation for the 4 bottom tabs (home, menu, peta, laporan), plus Scaffold with RadarNavBar at bottom and AppTopBar at top. Profile and Notifikasi are reachable from the AppTopBar actions (navigate to 'profile' and 'notifikasi' in the outer NavHost). Add composable('profile') and composable('notifikasi') in the outer NavHost. Logout from ProfileScreen navigates back to 'login' with full stack clear.
acceptance_criteria: Running .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug from android/ produces BUILD SUCCESSFUL
No WebView import exists in MainActivity.kt
findings: Build succeeded after two fixes: (1) Icons.Default.Visibility and Icons.Default.VisibilityOff are not in the base material-icons set — replaced with emoji text toggles in LoginScreen and RegisterScreen. (2) MapController.animateTo zoom parameter type: removed .toLong() cast since WilayahItem.zoom is already Double which matches the expected type. All 16 UI files created: 3 theme (Color, Type, Theme), 4 components (KpiCard, MenuCard, AppTopBar, NavBar), 9 screens (Splash, Login, Register, Home, Menu, Peta, Laporan, Profile, Notifikasi). MainActivity fully replaced with single-activity NavHost (enableEdgeToEdge, no WebView). MainScaffold has inner NavHost for 4 bottom tabs + RadarNavBar. PullToRefreshBox (M3 experimental) used in HomeScreen and NotifikasiScreen. OSMDroid AndroidView in PetaScreen with province markers and 3 simulated moving van markers updating every 3s. APK confirmed at android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk.
